title: Health graduates' sit-in outside Ministry of Health, reported as continuing Nov7

date.summary: GCHR report states that on Nov7 health graduates continued a sit-in with families outside the Ministry of Health after 15 days; source's implied onset is around Oct23 but is not printed as a precise start date.

location.summary: Outside the Ministry of Health, Baghdad, per cross-unit GCHR source.

continuity.summary: GCHR describes the Nov7 action as continuation of a 15-day sit-in; this is separate from the Oct6 medical-graduate demonstration and distinct from Nov12 unless evidence links them.

notes: Cross-unit source is Oct unit IQ24OCT-S004. Do not create an event onset in November from this follow-up alone. The source includes links to social-media posts; none opened.
